LanguageData.RjwTips.tips.1: RimJobWorld is a community project with more than 80 contributors. Thank you!
LanguageData.RjwTips.tips.2: RimJobWorld is open source and accepts submissions from anyone.
LanguageData.RjwTips.tips.3: The average bra size in RimJobWorld is 85DD. If you think that can't possibly be right because your wife has D cups and she is pretty big then she should probably be wearing a G cup.
LanguageData.RjwTips.tips.4: Most women wear a bra with too small a cup size and too large a band size.
LanguageData.RjwTips.tips.5: The average male erection contains about 190mL of blood. That's roughly the same volume as two espresso cups. Keep that in mind before you judge someone's "cup size".
LanguageData.RjwTips.tips.6: Vaginal lubrication is essentially plasma that leaks through vaginal walls due to increased blood flow. So technically, it's just filtered blood. Romantic, eh?
LanguageData.RjwTips.tips.7: Sexual fantasies are nearly universal, but content varies widely by gender and culture. Your peaceful vegan colonist might secretly dream about ravaging a raider - just sayin'.
LanguageData.RjwTips.tips.8: The G-spot isn't a distinct anatomical structure but an area where internal parts of the clitoris become engorged. So really, it's all connected. Have fun exploring the map, settlers.
LanguageData.RjwTips.tips.9: Testicles hang outside the body because sperm production requires slightly lower than body temperature. Evolution's solution: an external thermostat. Also makes sitting uncomfortable.
LanguageData.RjwTips.tips.10: Kissing releases a cocktail of hormones that reduce stress and increase bonding. So when your colonists make out after a raid, they're self-medicating. Very efficient.
LanguageData.RjwTips.tips.11: Early hormonal contraceptives used... yams. That's right: wild yam extract. Nothing says romance like a side dish of roasted vegetables.
LanguageData.RjwTips.tips.12: On some planets, semen is considered an "elixir" with health benefits. Here on the Rim, it's just another nutrient source for the cannibals.
LanguageData.RjwTips.tips.13: Sex dreams are common. Up to 80% of men and 60% of women report having them. Your sleeping colonists might be busier than they let on.
LanguageData.RjwTips.tips.14: The clitoral glans can be as small as a pea or as large as a walnut. Nature's variety pack. Bring a measuring tape to the next party.
LanguageData.RjwTips.tips.15: Sex burns roughly 3-5 calories per minute. So a 30-minute session burns about 90-150 calories! Less than a brisk walk, but definitely more fun.
LanguageData.RjwTips.tips.16: Many features in RimJobWorld are opt-in. Make sure to check out the mod settings.
LanguageData.RjwTips.tips.17: Relative frequency of male and female pawns can be controlled in RimJobWorld mod settings.
LanguageData.RjwTips.tips.18: Frequency of male pawns with breasts and females with penises can be controlled in RimJobWorld mod settings.
LanguageData.RjwTips.tips.19: Necrophilia is disabled by default. It can be enabled in RimJobWorld mod settings.
LanguageData.RjwTips.tips.20: Bestiality is disabled by default. It can be enabled in RimJobWorld mod settings.
LanguageData.RjwTips.tips.21: Rape is disabled by default. It can be enabled in RimJobWorld mod settings.
LanguageData.RjwTips.tips.22: Cannibalism is enabled by default. It can't be disabled in RimJobWorld mod settings because it is a feature of the base game.
LanguageData.RjwTips.tips.23: Sex need has a great many configuration options in RimJobWorld mod settings.
LanguageData.RjwTips.tips.24: Sexual preference is visible in the "Show sexuality" menu under the Bio tab (the icon looks like a torso).
LanguageData.RjwTips.tips.25: Condoms can be automatically used if placed in a stockpile next to a bed - it might be a good idea to have some around if you want to avoid unwanted pregnancies.
LanguageData.RjwTips.tips.26: Being sexually pent up lowers colonists' moods - be sure to let them blow off some steam!
LanguageData.RjwTips.tips.27: Humpshrooms and Aphrodisiacs can improve a pawn's mood, but also cause extreme arousal and can lead to more permanent alterations if abused.
LanguageData.RjwTips.tips.28: Rape will cause an extreme mood debuff, though after a while they might start to like the abuse.
LanguageData.RjwTips.tips.29: Sometimes a threat might be able to be subdued through sex and submission if you lack the firepower to deal with it.
LanguageData.RjwTips.tips.30: Some types of sex (such as sex with animals) have a chance of leaving a permanent mark on a pawn's psyche.
LanguageData.RjwTips.tips.31: Are your colonists bored? Let them have a tussle under the sheets, that'll cheer them up.
LanguageData.RjwTips.tips.32: The "Submit" button is one of the most powerful features added by any mod.
LanguageData.RjwTips.tips.33: RimJobWorld does not add any lewd graphics, you will need another mod for that. For example RimNude or Sized Apparel Zero for bodies.
LanguageData.RjwTips.tips.34: RimJobWorld does not add any lewd graphics, you will need another mod for that. For example Rimworld Animations Framework for animations.
LanguageData.RjwTips.tips.35: If you like twenty-breasted tittysnakes then try the Nephila submod.
LanguageData.RjwTips.tips.36: RimJobWorld is not compatible with the "Lost Forest" mod. This is a deliberate choice on the part of the author of Lost Forest to break your save if you have this mod installed.
LanguageData.RjwTips.tips.37: RimJobWorld has birth and pregnancy features, but no babies. Children will be born fully grown unless you have another mod that changes that.
LanguageData.RjwTips.tips.38: If you use RJW with any alien race mods, make sure you also install "RJW Race Support". Otherwise your Ewok won't have a raccoon penis.
